- **bar2-bot (45,1)**: object RIGHT 4, w2 LEFT 4 (mirror), w3 RIGHT 4
- **bar2-top (37,1)**: object LEFT 4, w2 RIGHT 4, w3 LEFT 4
- **bar1-bot (25,1)**: w1 LEFT 4, w2 RIGHT 4 (object unchanged)
- **bar1-top (17,1)**: w1 RIGHT 4, w2 LEFT 4 (object unchanged)
So **bar1-bot pushes w2 right** (giving the object room), and **bar2-bot moves the object right**. The combo `(bar1-bot, bar2-bot)` moves the object right by 4 with **w2 net-unchanged** (no left-edge blocking), at the cost of w1 shifting left (plenty of room). Green bar at 16, gap at 28 → need **+12 = 3 combos**.
